Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring notice of legislative committee hearings.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to notice of legislative committee hearings; andadding a new section to chapter 44.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) At least five days' notice must be given of all public hearingsheld by any legislative committee other than a committee on rules. Thenotice must contain the date, time, and place of the hearing togetherwith the title and number of each bill, or identification of thesubject matter, to be considered at the hearing. By a majority vote ofthe committee members present at any committee meeting, the notice maybe dispensed with. The reason for the action must be set forth in awritten statement preserved in the records of the meeting. (2) No legislative committee may hold a public hearing during aregular or special session on a proposal identified as a draft unlessthe draft has been made available to the public at least twentyfourhours before the hearing. This rule does not apply during the five p. 1 SB 6561days before any cutoff established by concurrent resolution nor does itapply to any measure exempted from the cutoff resolution.
